hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/staunton-river (main campground: 'Accepts outlets for 20 and 30-amp current', site types 'EW 45-ft - Electric and water hookups', 'There are no sewer hookups, but there is a dump station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Main campground: 48 sites including the camp host's: 4 EW 45-ft, 10 EW 30-ft, 20 EW pop-up/tent (units to 20 ft), 13 tents-only; not on the water. A separate equestrian campground has 13 electric/water sites with 20/30/50-amp pedestals (10 paved pull-throughs to 55 ft, 3 gravel back-ins to 45 ft) and 20 covered stalls; it is booked as 'Horse Site' units and stalls go only with an EQ campsite.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/staunton-river ('Total sites of each type : EW 45-ft, 4; EW 30-ft, 10; EW pop/tent, 20; Tent Std., 13', 'Total campsites : 48 (including camp host site)', 'Equestrian Camping : ... Sites 1-10 are pull-through ... up to 55 feet', 'All sites have electric pedestals, which have 20, 30 and 50-amp outlets') + reservevaparks.com (facility 145 Staunton River Campground: VehicleLength to 45; facility 142 Horse Campground: 13 'Horse Site' units), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Heated bathhouse with hot showers and a laundry (check off-season availability). Dump station in front of the bathhouse; another at the EQ campground. Dark Sky park: outside lights off 10 p.m. to dawn.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/staunton-river ('The bathhouse is heated and has hot showers', 'The laundry facility is in the campground bathhouse', 'there is a dump station ... located in front of the bathhouse'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the season (first Friday in March to first Monday in December) on the park page; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12 (the $27 no-hookup sites take units only to 20 ft, as recorded). Added 30-amp with water, no sewer, 48 sites to 45 ft, showers/laundry/dump. 50-amp and 55-ft pull-throughs exist only in the separate equestrian campground (noted, not recorded as the campground's). Booking left inherited.
